decision_rationale: Both candidate ML models demonstrate clear surrogate fidelity to theoretical FAO-56 net irrigation requirements (Random Forest MAE 2.15 m3/day, XGBoost MAE 2.42 m3/day, achieving >80% MAE reduction over Naive Mean Baseline on held-out future dates). However, because the reference target is mathematically calculated from agroclimatological formulas and single-station NASA POWER weather without measured farm-gate water delivery records, the candidate models MUST REMAIN OFFLINE CANDIDATES. Production activation is withheld until multi-year empirical irrigation observations from Maharashtra water user associations are curated.

provenance.agronomic_reference: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 + USDA SCS Effective Rainfall
